errors.evidence: The description states the x-axis range is from 2000 to 2022. However, the labeled ticks on the x-axis only go up to 2020. While the data extends to approximately 2022, this is the data range, not the axis range.

The description for the Germany line states that it falls from its starting point in 2000 until 2008. The chart shows that the line first rises from ~0.20% in 2000 to a peak of ~0.35% around 2002 before it starts to fall. This oversimplification misses a key trend reversal.
